# beatLabs

> Dubai-based design lab (BeatLabs FZE LLC): ideas turned into apps, websites and brands — each with its own name, domain, and identity.

beatLabs designs and builds its own apps and runs two studios for client work (brand, web and photography). Everything starts as an idea in the lab; each product then gets its own identity, audience, and business model.

## Apps

- [Nibango](https://nibango.com) — Local marketplace to buy, sell, bid and give away near you. Six categories with their own filters (including pay for jobs), four ways to deal, offers and counter-offers, nearby places in the chat, zero commission. iPhone, Android and web (nibango.com) in 17 languages. Live. Landing page in 17 languages: https://beatlabs.ae/nibango
- [Curb](https://getcurbapp.com) — Tracks subscriptions, installment plans and prepaid passes on iOS and Android, in 13 languages. No bank access, 33 currencies, one-time Pro purchase. Live.
- [Raved](https://raved.app) — An inbox for recommendations: save every film, show, book, album, podcast and place your friends rave about, with a Home Screen widget and an optional reminder. iOS and Android, in 6 languages. Live.
- [Blab](https://blab.day) — A small social network for saying what you think, in 28 worlds of people who share your interests, with one optional daily challenge. iOS, Android and web (blab.day), in 13 languages. Live.

## Web & Creative

- [TrueLoveCreative](https://truelovecreative.es) — Web and graphic design studio in Dubai.
- [Estrela.photo](https://estrela.photo) — Photographer for artists, DJs and performers in Dubai.
